title: Incognito presence and plain error boxes — round 5

steps.headline: Incognito now shows how many friends are online, while they still can't see you.
steps.changed: Your device connects to friends in a hidden mode: it hears who's online, and friends never see it. The line reads "2 of 4 friends online · they can't see you".
steps.notice: Connect 4 and Chess still say "You're incognito"; challenging stays off until you go online, because a challenge would reveal you.

steps.headline: Opened while incognito, each friend shows their real status again.
steps.changed: Online, In game and Offline pills are back while you're incognito; round 4 hid them because nothing about friends reached the app.
steps.notice: Only this device is hidden: if you're online on another device, friends see that one.

steps.headline: The install error loses its red title: one plain sentence with the real reason, and Retry install.
steps.changed: "Couldn't install" in red above the reason is gone; the reason itself is the sentence (it already says what failed).
steps.notice: Same red box and button; the words are all normal colour.

steps.path: Settings → Assistant → Local → a model's settings
steps.headline: The local model's load error is one plain sentence too, with the engine's exact message after it.
steps.changed: "This model failed to load last time" was a red title; now it starts the sentence, in normal colour.
steps.notice: Every red notice box in the app now uses normal-colour words; the red stays in the box and its border.
